notes.title: 🍓 ANNOUNCING THE STRAWBERRY REVOLUTION 🍓
notes.content:
[h2]🧩 SLEEK. SMOOTH. SATISFYING.[/h2]
[h3]Discover the new feel of clicking.[/h3]

We’ve supercharged the visual feedback and streamlined navigation to make every click feel [b]magical[/b]. It’s not just a game—it’s a [b]sensory delight[/b].


[h2]🌱 60% LIGHTER. 100% GREENER [/h2]
[h3]Strawberry’s never tasted this clean.[/h3]

We’ve slashed resource usage by [b]60%[/b]—less RAM, more room for strawberries (and your other apps). Play longer, smoother, and guilt-free, knowing you’re part of a greener, cleaner future. 🌍


[h2]💾 YOUR SAVE. YOUR JOURNEY (NO COMPROMISES)[/h2]
[h3]This is YOUR world. We’re just living in it.  [/h3]

Introducing [b]dedicated Steam Cloud saves[/b]. Your progress? Now untouchable. Your choices? Forever yours. Switch devices, take breaks, or start fresh—your journey is yours alone. And yes, [b]your strawberries are safe[/b].


[h2]⚖️ EQUAL GROUND. EQUAL STRAWBERRIES[/h2]
[h3]No internet? Old laptop? We’ve got you.[/h3]

We [b]heard you[/b]. We saw you. And we [b]acted[/b]. Introducing a [b]3-minute grace period[/b] for every players—because fairness isn’t a luxury. Plus, our offline mode is now [b]turbo-optimized[/b] for slower setups. Whether you’re on a spaceship or a potato PC, [b]your strawberries matter.[/b] 🌟  


[h2]🎯 FOR THE COMMUNITY [/h2]

This update isn’t just about [b]what’s new[/b]—it’s about [b]who we’re building for[/b]. [b]You.[/b] The clickers, the strategists, the midnight strawberry hoarders. Together, we’re crafting a world where [b]every click counts[/b] and [b]every player thrives[/b].  


[h2]🔥 READY TO DIVE IN? [/h2]
[h3]Update now. Trade smarter. Click louder.  [/h3]

**P.S.** Tag your fellow farmers in the [b]comments[/b], let's build history [b]together[/b]. 🍓✨

#StrawberryRevolution #ClickDifferent #Clicker

notes.title: 🍓Strawberry Launch Event🍓
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Strawberry - Launch Event! [/h1]

We're excited to announce the launch of Strawberry! To celebrate this special occasion, we've prepared some sweet rewards for our players.

    [h2]Steam Item Rewards[/h2]    

Every 3 hours of gameplay, you'll receive a delicious strawberry to add to your collection!

    [h2]Special Launch Day Bonus[/h2]    

[h3][b]First 24 Hours Only![/b][/h3]
    
Don't miss out on the chance to obtain the exclusive [b]Day1Strawberry[/b]! This special collectible will only be available during the first 24 hours after launch.
    
Join us now and start your strawberry collecting adventure!
    
Happy collecting! 🍓
